description: Use when you need to confirm that a transaction paid at least an amount of an asset to an address: pass tx, to, amount and asset. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /pay/check, $0.003 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Checks a payment against an expected recipient and amount; for raw transaction fields use evm_transaction, for status and logs use evm_receipt. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

amount.description: Minimum amount in asset units (not base units), e.g. 0.01; paid >= amount gives verified=true

asset.description: USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, ETH, POL or a listed token address

chain.description: ethereum, base, arbitrum or polygon (optional for EVM)

to.description: Expected recipient; transfers to other addresses do not count

name: pay_check
title: Pay check
